values.NOT_SUPPLIED_CURRENT_SUPPLIER: The supplier's hold was canceled, or has gone missing, in its host LMS. If the consortium has 'Re-resolution' turned on and the patron did not choose a particular item, OpenRS DCB resolves the request again, excluding this supplier. Otherwise, or if no other library can supply, the request moves to 'No items selectable at any agency'.
values.NO_ITEMS_SELECTABLE_AT_ANY_AGENCY: Resolution found no item that any library could supply, so the request will not be filled. OpenRS DCB cancels any holds it placed, then finalizes the request.
values.AWAITING_RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: The patron's hold was canceled after the item had left the supplying library. OpenRS DCB keeps its records and keeps tracking the item until it is back, then cancels and finalizes the request.
values.CANCELLED: The request was canceled before the item left the supplier, or the item has since gone back. OpenRS DCB has canceled its holds, and finalizes the request next.
values.COMPLETED: Nothing more is needed from the libraries: the supplier's host LMS reports the item back, or the request was cleaned up. OpenRS DCB finalizes it next.

waiting.NO_ITEMS_SELECTABLE_AT_ANY_AGENCY: In this status, the finalization process runs straight away. A request that stays here has not finalized; the audit log shows the last attempt.
waiting.REQUEST_PLACED_AT_SUPPLYING_AGENCY: The supplier has not yet confirmed the hold. Compare 'Local request status' on the 'Supplying' tab: OpenRS DCB moves on when it reads the hold as confirmed or in transit, and to 'Not supplied by current supplier' if the hold is canceled or missing.
waiting.READY_FOR_PICKUP: The item has not yet been checked out to the patron. OpenRS DCB moves on when the item is checked out. If the patron's hold is canceled first, the request moves to 'Awaiting return to supplier'.
waiting.CANCELLED: Finalizing runs straight away. A request that stays here has not finalized; the audit log shows the last attempt.
waiting.COMPLETED: Finalizing runs straight away. A request that stays here has not finalized; the audit log shows the last attempt.

insights.subtitle: Requesting activity, fulfillment and value for {{library}}.

transit_dwell_trend.not: It measures the status, not the courier: an item scanned late at the receiving end is indistinguishable from one that traveled slowly. A system that does not report the return leg contributes nothing to it rather than contributing a zero.

requests_fulfilled.how: The successful and failed counts from the borrower fulfillment query, added together. Successful means the request reached loaned, completed or finalized.

items_supplied.not: Local fulfillment is excluded: an item this library supplied to its own patron is not network traffic.

turnaround_to_finalise.how: Median and 95th percentile from request creation to the first audit entry reaching finalized.
turnaround_to_finalise.not: Finalization trails the patron's experience by a long way - the item has usually been back on the shelf for some time - so this is an operations figure, not a service one.

supplier_reliability.how: Per supplier, requests that reached loaned, completed or finalized against those that errored, were canceled, or found no selectable item.

trading_partners.how: Requests grouped by the partner at the other end, excluding errored requests and local fulfillment, because a failed request is not traffic and a local loan is not a partnership.

peer_benchmarks.not: It is deliberately not pseudonymized: members are named, because a benchmark nobody can act on is decoration.

cost_avoidance.what: What these fulfillments would have cost through traditional interlibrary loan.
cost_avoidance.how: Successful fulfillments in the window multiplied by a unit cost you supply. No cost is shipped with the product.

walk_up_diversion.what: How many requests the reader collected in person at the supplying library, and how many traveled to their own.

collection_totals.what: The consortium's shared catalog in four numbers: distinct works, works only one library holds, holdings, and the libraries contributing records.

collection_profile.what: Each library's works in the shared catalog, and how many of them no other library holds.

collection.section_subtitle: The catalog as ingested, rather than the traffic over it. These figures count works held, not requests made, so the date range does not apply to them.
collection.computing: Counting across the whole catalog. The first count can take several minutes, and this panel will check again on its own.

profile.subtitle: Works contributed to the shared catalog, and how many of them nobody else holds. This library is highlighted.

accessibility.tested_body: Automated checks run on every change and block a release if they fail: an axe scan of every screen and dialog in the accessibility gate, in light and dark and at a 320-pixel width, arithmetic over every color pair in each of the three schemes, and a check that every field label is still attached to its value. Automated testing finds roughly a third of accessibility problems, so it is a floor rather than a guarantee.
accessibility.limits_body: Data grids are wide, and reading one on a narrow screen still means scrolling sideways. Your sign-in ends when your organization's sign-in service says it does, without a warning first, and a change you had not yet saved is lost with it. Some charts convey trends by shape; each carries its figures as a table for screen readers, but the shape itself is not described in words. We have not yet had this interface tested by an external auditor.
accessibility.settings_body: Under Preferences you can choose a color scheme including high contrast, a text size, a typeface including Atkinson Hyperlegible, how tightly the interface is spaced, whether it animates, whether times are shown on your clock or on the service's, and whether it is written in American or British English. These are stored on your own device and are not shared with colleagues.

brand.theme_help: Applied when a patron is searching your library. Every theme has been checked for color contrast in light, dark and high-contrast modes.

statistics.top_titles_month: Your patrons' favorite titles this month

patron_request.cleanup_disabled: Cleanup is available to the borrowing library and to a supplying library, for a request that is in error or whose item has not yet been shipped.
patron_request.cleanup_disabled_guarded: Cleanup is available to the borrowing library and to a supplying library, until the request is finished.

cleanup_override.warning_one: DCB refused this cleanup because the item is not back at the supplying library. Cleaning up now deletes the borrowing library's temporary records, which leaves the supplying library nothing to check the item in against. Only continue once you have confirmed where the item is.
cleanup_override.warning_other: DCB refused these {{count}} cleanups because their items are not back at the supplying libraries. Cleaning up now deletes the borrowing libraries' temporary records, which leaves the supplying libraries nothing to check the items in against. Only continue once you have confirmed where each item is.

patron_request.cleanup_successful: The request has been cleaned up and finalized.

confirm_returned.body: Do this once the item is back at your library. DCB then releases the request as if your library system had reported it: a canceled request finishes as canceled, and a returned loan completes.

errors.cluster_deleted: This item's catalog entry has been removed, so it cannot be lent through a walk-up.
errors.item_not_in_shared_index: This item's record is not in the shared catalog yet, so it cannot be lent through a walk-up.

selection.automatic_context: DCB will automatically select an item to fulfill this request.
selection.manual_context: DCB will use the criteria provided to select an item to fulfill this request

home.heading: A personalized OpenRS summary for your library
home.body: The Home page now shows a personalized summary of your library's OpenRS activity for today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days.
